payload.name: Context-dependent habit disruption
payload.fact: When the usual context for performing a habit changes, the habit cannot be cued by its recurring stimuli and performance is disrupted; habits survive a context change only when aspects of the performance context remain unchanged.
payload.boundary: Habits survive transfer to new environments only when aspects of the performance context remain unchanged.

provenance.title: Changing circumstances, disrupting habits.
provenance.quote_or_locus: When usual contexts for performance change, habits cannot be cued by recurring stimuli, and performance should be disrupted. Thus, the exercising, newspaper reading, and TV watching habits of students transferring to a new university were found to survive the transfer only when aspects of the performance context did not change

payload.grade_basis: Mechanical single-source grade cap (owner rule, 2026-08-10): 1 source -> C+ max, 2 sources -> B- max, 3+ independent sources -> B max, A band only with a meta-analysis or replication in the cited set. Computed grading does not exist yet; this is the interim mechanical floor. This claim: 1 independent source(s), original model-asserted grade A -> capped to C+.
